alternatives.name: Back Navigation
alternatives.reason: The full pattern for going back.

accessibility: The chevron is decorative, so it's aria-hidden, and the whole row is the button.
Back buttons name the screen they return to in text.
When the screen changes, move focus to the new screen's first button.
When rotating the icon shows expansion, use aria-expanded too.
